title: [main] Bug 657914 Total Number of Supplies has incorrect type and tooltip in the VAT Report page of the German version.
summary: The Total Number of Supplies field in the VAT Report page is corrected to display as a whole number instead of an amount with decimal places in the German version.
key_points: Field 33 Total Number of Supplies in VAT Report Header is a Decimal FlowField that was formatted as an amount, so it showed two decimal places
It now shows as a whole number, the same way the summed line field Number of Supplies does (AutoFormatType 0, DecimalPlaces 0:0)
The field stays Decimal, which avoids a breaking schema change to Integer
Applies to the German (DE) layer of the VAT Report page and table
quote: Total Number of Supplies has incorrect type and tooltip in the VAT Report page of the German version.
